thread:
Maria (Support): @everyone getting multiple reports of 5xx/gateway errors for hosted inference since ~12:58 UTC. Ticket CS-3421 flagged by a major customer (AcmeCorp). Error snippets: "502 Bad Gateway", "upstream timed out (110)". No clear request pattern yet.

Anna (Support): saw same — spike in timeouts on /v1/generate, p99 latency jumped to ~2.8s then 10s then 504s. Posting a stack from gateway logs.

sre-bot: ALERT: redis-cache-cluster latency > 500ms (12:56 UTC) :rotating_light:

Dan (SRE): I'm on it. Any recent deploys to cache client or runtime?

Kevin (Eng Runtime): We pushed a runtime cache change at 12:43 — enabled prefix-based lua deletes in our cache service (feature flag: enable_prefix_lua). It changed how we do bulk invalidation and added a script that scans keys by prefix to avoid full flushes.

Maria (Support): timeline aligns. Customer says errors started ~12:55 after a series of bulk invalidations.

Dan (SRE): grabbing metrics. Can someone paste redis INFO and gateway error snippet?

Anna (Support): logs:
```text
[12:58:03] gateway: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header
[12:58:05] 502 from runtime (handler.go:248) request_id=RID-9f3a
```

Kevin (Eng Runtime): Redis slowlog and INFO snippets:
```text
# SLOWLOG
16789012 345 0.018 "EVALSHA" "<sha>" 2 "prefix_cache:v1:abc" 0
# INFO stats
instantaneous_ops_per_sec:1200
keyspace_misses:84521
evicted_keys:0
db0:keys=220000,expires=0,avg_ttl=0
used_memory:524288000
used_memory_rss:820000000
maxmemory:536870912
```

Dan (SRE): used_memory close to maxmemory -> Redis started doing expensive evicting/slower responses; EVALSHA calls for prefix lua are expensive. Likely scripts are blocking the event loop and causing timeouts. Also seeing RESP 'BUSY' in some logs.

Dan (SRE): immediate mitigations: 1) disable enable_prefix_lua flag (rollback), 2) scale redis replicas & bump maxmemory, 3) enable cache fallback to cold path for critical routes (bypass cache at runtime), 4) set circuit breaker on gateway for repeated 502/504 to avoid cascading.

Kevin (Eng Runtime): rolling flag rollback now. @deploy-bot initiate rollback of cache-worker-flag -> confirmed started.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued (job 78923), ETA 2m

Anna (Support): Confirmed: after rollback began p99 dropped from 10s to 0.9s within ~3 minutes. Customer reporting less errors.

Maria (Support): Customer update: AcmeCorp says errors stopped around 13:09 UTC, currently green. They've requested root cause and ETA for fix.

Dan (SRE): Postmortem action items: 1) add unit tests for prefix-LUA at scale, 2) add canary that runs prefix scripts on a small dataset only, 3) add monitoring alert for blocking scripts & slow EVALSHAs, 4) run capacity test for bulk invalidation path, 5) document runbook for cache service OOM/BUSY events. I'll open INC-2026 and PM-ticket.

Kevin (Eng Runtime): We'll also implement a non-blocking keywalk invalidation (cursor based) rather than single EVAL for large keysets and add feature flag gating by keyspace size.

Dan (SRE): closing thread once postmortem created. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
